title: DMM memory map, cache and DMA coherency
summary: DDR-A/DDR-B use from DmmConfig.bin, the work DMA at 0xF0102000, the 0xF30A fill engine and the cache maintenance that keeps Linux and av-cam coherent.
questions: Which physical DRAM extents does av-cam own versus borrow from Linux, and how is DmmConfig.bin interpreted at run time?
What is the work-DMA descriptor/start/stop/busy contract (E0640), and which transfers use it rather than a PL080 channel?
What does the 0xF30A fill engine do, and how does a guest observe completion?
Where are the cache clean/invalidate points around shared buffers?
deliverable: Memory and DMA contract: extents, descriptors, completion and coherency rules, with the minimal set needed for boot (M1).
